name: pwr_currentconsumption_stop_underdrive
description: PWR_CurrentConsumption in under-drive Stop mode (STOP_UNDERDRIVE_MODE, the readme's third line): HAL_PWREx_EnterUnderDriveSTOPMode clears UDRDY and sets UDEN, but the example passes it PWR_LOWPOWERREGULATOR_ON (LPDS without LPUDS), and under-drive takes UDEN with LPUDS or MRUDS (RM0390 5.3.4): the part enters Stop on the low-power regulator, and PWR_CSR's UDRDY stays 0 (VOSRDY clear too, the PLL off). After B1 (held from 0.5 to 1.2 s), 0xA000 periods of LSI/16 later (20.48 s at the 32 kHz LSI) the RTC's wake-up interrupt ends Stop, the callback sets uwCounter to 1 and LD2 toggles every 100 ms.
